BiblicalUsage: Chacal means to consume, to finish off. Moses warns that Israel will carry much seed into the field and gather little, because the locust will consume it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the locust is God's arithmetic: much seed in, little harvest out, when His people will not listen.
